req.title: Basic-auth handles special characters
req.statement: The system shall URL-decode <user> and <passwd> path segments before comparing against the supplied Basic credentials.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should URL-decode the <user> and <passwd> path segments before comparing them against the supplied Basic credentials. This means we need to test that special characters in the username and password are correctly decoded and authenticated. We will create tests to cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure the system behaves as expected.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_special_characters_positive
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user%40example.com/pass%40word with correct Basic Auth credentials.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user%40example.com/pass%40word', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic dXNlckBleGFtcGxlLmNvbTpwYXNzQHdvcmQ='})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json == {'authenticated': True, 'user': 'user@example.com'}

tests.name: test_basic_auth_special_characters_negative
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user%40example.com/pass%40word with incorrect Basic Auth credentials.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user%40example.com/pass%40word', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic dXNlckBleGFtcGxlLmNvbTppbmNvcnJlY3Q='})
assert response.status_code == 401

tests.name: test_basic_auth_special_characters_boundary
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/%40/pass%40word with correct Basic Auth credentials.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/basic-auth/%40/pass%40word', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic QDpAZXhhbXBsZS5jb20='})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json == {'authenticated': True, 'user': '@'}
